title: Parallelising Huffman decoding and x86 disassembly by synchronising non-self-synchronising prefix codes
relevance: Primary reference. Introduces the probe convergence algorithm for finding sync points in Huffman bitstreams. Shows ~25% speedup on Apple M1 with 2-way parallel DEFLATE decode.

title: Self-synchronization of Huffman codes
relevance: Theoretical analysis of Huffman code self-synchronization properties. Provides mathematical framework for convergence probability bounds.

title: Massively Parallel Huffman Decoding on GPUs
relevance: GPU-parallel Huffman decoder exploiting self-synchronization property. Demonstrates >10x speedup over CPU Zstandard decoder. Shows that sync-point approaches scale to massive parallelism.

title: JParEnt: Parallel entropy decoding for JPEG decompression on heterogeneous multicore architectures
relevance: Parallel entropy decoding for JPEG using sync-point techniques. Demonstrates applicability to real image format decompression.
